title: geranium eriostemon var. reinii
intro: Geranium eriostemon var. reinii, commonly known as the Sweet Scented Geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Geranium eriostemon var. reinii include its ability to stimulate the circulatory system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and citronellol, which have been shown to have antibacterial and antioxidant properties.
